column4: Only 5 letters and could plausibly collide; kept to whole-brand match for safety.
Lerwick is also Shetland's capital town/port name, so restricted to whole-brand match to avoid false hits inside unrelated names.

Lochranza is the Isle of Arran distillery's own site name (the original distillery, as distinct from its 2019 sister site Lagg, where the peated Machrie Moor spirit is now made) - not a separate distillery. Wikipedia's 'Arran distillery' article is a #REDIRECT to 'Lochranza distillery'. producerSlug=arran is defined in out/02, out/03, out/06, out/13/producer.tsv (this batch did not duplicate it, per the merge-dedup instruction). See also the existing machrie-moor row (out/02, parentSlug=arran, peatProfile=medium), which already covers the peated line.
See note on the 'Lochranza' alias above; producerSlug=arran is external to this batch.
